verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no native automation or agent runner. Users can still build background automation from its parts: signed webhooks fire on pushes, issues and merged PRs; Buildkite CI results show up as checks; GitHub sync and branch mirroring keep repositories in sync without manual steps; and personal access tokens plus a non-interactive CLI/API (`--json`, `--no-input`, idempotent `requestId`) support scripts and CI jobs. Missing for 10: a built-in workflow/actions runner or scheduled jobs, autonomous background agents hosted by GitCafe, and any hands-on corroboration that automations run end-to-end without external infrastructure.
